fusions.name: Dosed Barb
fusions.desc: Throws a dosed barb that deals 4 damage, with a 50% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Drawn to the Dregs
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, with 60% more damage for each. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt, and the target is left 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shake the Venom
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: No Quarry Immune
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.
